evidence_quotes.O: This thing looks way cool. It's a nice techno-retro mix that I really like.
evidence_quotes.C: To clean a disc you spray it a couple times, place it in the spinner (label down), close the lid, and turn the crank 20 times.
evidence_quotes.E: It is a small camera and carries with it the baggage that comes with the convenience of having to carry so little baggage. (sorry, couldn't resist)
evidence_quotes.A: What I want to do is add some value to the many reviews that have already been posted.
evidence_quotes.N: I ran an accidental durability test when I dropped it onto a hard surface while it was plugged in and spinning. It continued working without a hiccup.
